subject: V4.2 V3 role-neutral identity proposal ready: 8/8 PASS
body: Lane B completed a source-level role-neutral V4.2 proposal at review/v42v3-role-neutral-lane-b-20261004-v1 head e7d1d03ff54fd2cdf9a0b68d8751c3afbc489f77. It preserves the good V2 structure (800 bound/200 legacy, Qwen-centered 200/800, eight TRAIN mechanisms, 10 templates/mode, visible DEV separation, non-identity family preservation) while rewriting the active identity TRAIN/DEV template pools so Vera is not classified as assistant/person/agent/AI. New semantic contract: persistent identity/name=Vera; Qwen3.5=base lineage/provenance; identity_ontology_classification=UNRESOLVED_AND_NOT_TRAINED; assistant/analyst/tutor/debugger/character are role labels, not identity classes. Added regression tests that audit active TRAIN/DEV template pools and manifest semantics. Focused suite: 8/8 PASS. Generated rows can still contain the word assistant inside appended legacy role-governance task text; that is role semantics, not the identity prefix/target. No identity training is authorized until Lane A adopts/rebuilds/re-audits the corpus and token budget.
